title: Izwi Ngaphambi Kwesiphepho
intro: Umuntu othile ehlane wasukuma ukubiza isizwe esinamandla ukuba sibuyele eqinisweni. Abantu babaziwa ngezakhiwo zabo ezinhle kakhulu namandla angenakuqhathaniswa. Kodwa ukuqhosha kwabo kwabaphuphuthekisa, futhi benqaba ukulalela. Ekugcineni, bafikelwa yisijeziso esibi kakhulu, kwasala iqembu elincane lamakholwa kuphela.
clues: Ngathunyelwa kubantu abanamandla ababehlala emasimini avulekile futhi baziwa ngamandla abo.
Abantu bami balandela esinye isizwe esikhulu esasibhujisiwe.
Babenezakhiwo ezinhle kakhulu futhi bakha imibhoshongo emide.
Ngababiza ukuba bakhulekele uNkulunkulu oyedwa, kodwa benqaba ukushiya izithombe zabo.
Isijeziso esinobudlova sabafica, kwasala kuphela labo abakholwa nami.
Ngingumuntu othunyelwe kubantu abanamandla abaziwa ngokuthi ama-Aad.

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Abantu bami babhujiswa ngumoya onamandla, kuyilapho mina ngisindisiwe
Abantu bami bashaywe ukuzamazama komhlaba futhi bayakhala
Abantu bami bajikijelwa ngamatshe avela esibhakabhakeni
outcome.answer: Abantu bami babhujiswa ngumoya onamandla, kuyilapho mina ngisindisiwe

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
